import math, random

def true_tan(a, b, c):
    s = a + b + c
    th = (math.atan(math.sqrt(a*s/(b*c))) + math.atan(math.sqrt(b*s/(c*a)))
          + math.atan(math.sqrt(c*s/(a*b))))
    return math.tan(th), th

def submitted(a, b, c):
    s = a + b + c
    A, B, C = math.sqrt(a*s), math.sqrt(b*s), math.sqrt(c*s)
    r = math.sqrt(a*b*c)
    num = A + B + C - r
    den = r + A*B + B*C + C*A
    return num / den

random.seed(1)
